items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: And all bands like that played with territories, Zack White, Helvey's band... He was used to playing with bands like Zack White, Helvey and all those type of bands

ctx.x: And all bands like that played with territories, Zack White, Helvey's band, but my -- the most impressive band I ever heard was Alphonso Trent out of Little Rock. Oh, man, he had a good little band. And --
What was it you liked about the band?
